definitions.explanation: A facility where young children are looked after while their parents are at work or otherwise occupied. Can range from small private operations to larger institutional facilities.

examples.japanese: {託児所|たくじしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}けた→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: I left my child at the daycare center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{託児所|たくじしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{併設|へいせつ}→併設：11693_heisetsu⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The venue has an attached childcare facility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{託児所|たくじしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}けられる→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: A new daycare center opened in front of the station, so I can now drop off my child on my way to work.

notes:
A general term for any childcare facility. Often used for smaller or temporary operations, such as those set up at event venues, shopping centers, or workplaces, as opposed to full-scale ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {託児所|たくじしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to leave a child at daycare
- {託児所|たくじしょ}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with childcare facilities
- ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧{託児所|たくじしょ}: temporary daycare
- {院内|いんない}{託児所|たくじしょ}: in-hospital daycare
- {事業所内|じぎょうしょない}{託児所|たくじしょ}: workplace daycare

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧: nursery school — a licensed facility with stricter standards and longer hours, primarily for working parents
- ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧: kindergarten — an educational institution under the Ministry of Education for children ages 3-5, with shorter hours
